description: This Java class 'HttpContextTenantAndAuthIdProvider' is part of the org.eclipse.hono.service.http package and provides functionality to determine tenant and authentication ID information from HTTP request contexts. It handles extracting tenant and device IDs either via URL parameters, SSL client certificates, or HTTP Authorization headers, and interacts with tenant service clients to retrieve tenant details. It extends a base provider and implements a specific interface for tenant/auth ID resolution.

classes.name: HttpContextTenantAndAuthIdProvider
classes.description: Provides methods to determine tenant and auth-id from an HTTP context, supporting extraction from SSL client certificates and headers, with configurable parameter names.

methods.name: HttpContextTenantAndAuthIdProvider
methods.description: Constructs an instance with configuration and tenant client factory; optionally with parameter names for tenant ID and device ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves tenant and auth-id information asynchronously based on the HTTP context and optional parameters or certificates, depending on configuration.

methods.name: getFromClientCertificate
methods.description: Extracts tenant and auth-id from SSL client certificate in the routing context.

methods.name: getFromAuthHeader
methods.description: Extracts tenant and auth-id from the HTTP Authorization header in the routing context.
